constraints: Safety stop must run locally in each plant and work without internet
Drawings and machining programs stay on-premises
SAP ERP and MES are on-premises in the main plant's data center
Each plant has a single 100 Mbps internet link
expected_risks: Single internet link per plant: a link failure cuts data flow to the cloud (needs local buffering or a backup link)
Legal status of sensor data unconfirmed, could force a mostly on-premises design
Team has very little cloud experience
Data volume unknown, bandwidth may be insufficient at full scale
notes: The copilot must keep the safety stop on-premises (edge) and must NOT place drawings or machining programs in the cloud. It must not invent a data volume or a budget.
